messages.subject: How Do Active Hours Work?
parts:
I'm confused about how active hours are computed.  I've created a couple apps and, checking out my usage stats, I see that I've already used 2 hours and they're still ticking away.  My apps are listed as running and have not gone to sleep, even though nobody's using them as far as I know.  Since the basic package is limited to 25 active hours per month, does this mean that all of my hours will be depleted by this time tomorrow?  I feel like my apps should be sleeping, but I don't see an option to put them to sleep, only to archive them.

Andrew

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: How Do Active Hours Work?
parts: Yes, definitely.   You can change the Connection Timeout setting for the application, under settings.  Setting that to a lower number will cause shinyapps.io to consider a connedtion inactive sooner.  The default is 15 minutes.
